content.user_title: Draft Stronger Documents With Guided Coauthoring
content.value_statement: Complex documents fail when context, structure, and reader needs are unclear. This skill guides context gathering, section drafting, refinement, and reader testing.
actual_capabilities: Collects document goals, audience, templates, constraints, and source context before drafting.
Builds an outline with placeholders for each agreed section.
Guides section-by-section brainstorming, curation, drafting, and focused edits.
Uses available artifacts or local markdown files for shared drafts.
Tests finished documents with fresh-reader questions and ambiguity checks.
Prompts final owner review for facts, links, and technical details.
limitations: It depends on the user to provide accurate context and source material.
It cannot access private tools or shared documents unless integrations are available and authorized.
It does not verify factual claims, links, or technical details automatically.
It may take multiple iterations for long or sensitive documents.

use_cases.title: Draft Technical Specs
use_cases.description: Turn architecture context, constraints, and tradeoffs into a structured technical specification.

use_cases.title: Prepare Decision Records
use_cases.description: Capture options, rationale, risks, and expected impact for a clear decision document.

use_cases.title: Improve Internal Proposals
use_cases.description: Shape rough notes into a proposal that stakeholders can understand and review.

prompt_templates.title: Start a New Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me write a technical spec. Ask me for the goal, audience, constraints, and any template before drafting.

prompt_templates.title: Turn Notes Into Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Convert rough context into a usable outline.
prompt_templates.prompt: I have rough notes for a proposal. Organize them into sections, identify missing context, and ask clarifying questions.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a Section
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve one section through guided iteration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the coauthoring workflow on the risks section. Brainstorm options, let me choose points, then draft and edit the section.

prompt_templates.title: Run Reader Testing
prompt_templates.scenario: Evaluate a completed document before sharing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Test this completed decision document as a new reader. Generate likely reader questions, find ambiguity, and suggest targeted fixes.

output_examples.input: User asks for a proposal and shares audience, timeline, and rough notes.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks targeted follow-up questions, proposes a section outline, and creates a draft scaffold with placeholders.

output_examples.input: User finishes a technical approach section and asks for feedback.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies redundancy, missing tradeoffs, and unclear assumptions, then applies focused edits to the existing draft.

output_examples.input: User wants to know whether a finished decision record is clear.
output_examples.output: The assistant generates reader questions, checks likely misunderstandings, and recommends precise changes before publication.

best_practices: Share audience, desired impact, constraints, and source material before asking for draft text.
Review each section after drafting so the assistant can learn your style and priorities.
Run reader testing before publication, then verify facts and links yourself.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a full polished document before providing core context.
Do not skip reader testing for documents that guide decisions or implementation.
Do not rely on the assistant as the only reviewer for facts or approvals.

faq.question: What documents does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision records, RFCs, and similar structured documents.

faq.question: Can it work with an existing template?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the template or describe the required format before drafting begins.

faq.question: Does it create files?
faq.answer: Yes, when file access is available. It can create a markdown scaffold and update sections during refinement.

faq.question: Can it read Slack or Google Drive?
faq.answer: Only when approved integrations are available. Otherwise, paste the relevant context directly into the conversation.

faq.question: Does it replace human review?
faq.answer: No. The document owner must verify facts, links, technical details, and final approval requirements.

faq.question: Why use reader testing?
faq.answer: Reader testing finds unclear assumptions, missing context, and questions that real readers may ask.
